'''Hanna City''' was the [[capital]] of the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]]. During the [[New Republic Era]], the city was a beacon of the [[New Republic]] and briefly served as its capital.

==Description==
{{Quote|Hanna City reflects the Senate's humble new beginnings—we're here for the people of the galaxy, all the hardworking people. And Mon Mothma is from here, so–|[[Olia Choko]]|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
Hanna City was a large [[city]] that was the [[capital]] of [[Chandrila]]. Built right on the expansive [[Silver Sea]], the city's white, cliff-like structures,<ref name="Life Debt" /> towering spires, and domed buildings<ref name="Last Shot" /> met right against its pebbled beaches. The ocean provided the [[fishing]] industry to the city's business, with a [[Hanna City fishery|fishery]] and docks being located near [[Barbican Road]].<ref name="Life Debt" /> The city streets were often bustling with crowds of people. [[Speeder]] traffic near the central docking station was also common during midday.<ref name="Last Shot" /> Hanna City had hundreds of landing platforms, managed by Chandrila tower control, to accommodate the large population.<ref name="Life Debt" /> One of the larger buildings in the city was the [[New Republic Defense Fleet headquarters]], which stood a gleaming monolith of the New Republic.<ref name="Last Shot" />

Outside Hanna City lay beautiful landscapes of misty [[forest]]s<ref name="Last Shot" /> and windswept meadows, which were all around the city and visible from some of the taller buildings.<ref name="Aftermath" /> There were also other seaside destinations such as [[Junari Point]], which was a few [[kilometer]]s outside the city.<ref name="Life Debt" />

==History==
[[File:ANewDawnPoster-Unlettered.png|thumb|left|190px|Hanna City was the seat of the New Republic Senate]]
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy]] launched an [[attack on Hanna City]] early in the [[Clone Wars]] for reasons that were never clear to [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], who pondered if the failed assault was an attempt at striking fear into their hearts.<ref name="MoF">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref>

Its [[governor]]<ref name="Aldhani" /> in [[5 BBY]]<ref name="Andor date">{{AndorDate|104}}</ref> was a friend of [[Perrin Fertha]], having served with him in the same [[regiment]]. The governor attended a dinner party thrown by Fertha at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] that year.<ref name="Aldhani" /> The [[city]] was home to the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] of the [[New Republic]], as [[Mon Mothma]] decided to have her [[homeworld]] of Chandrila to serve as the Republic's capital after the [[Battle of Endor]]. In the first [[Standard day|days]] of the new Senate, Hanna City featured an art installation in the city circle featuring [[stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor|helmets]] painted with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] sigils, starbursts, and other various [[color]]s. The [[HoloNews]] network [[Queen of the Core Network]]'s first day involved broadcasting the festivities at Hanna City.<ref name="Aftermath" />
